summary: Nigel Hungerford-Symes shares the prompt used with Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code to generate a 3D exploded view promo animation of a 3D-printable enclosure with text annotations.
summaryEn: Claude Code 3D Enclosure Promo Video Prompt

post.originalText:
Claude Opus 5.5 continues to amaze me. Claude Opus 5.5 created a 3D printable enclosure for an existing PCB.  Then it created this promo video for it. 
The PCB, the printable STLs and this animation are 100% just from prompting in Claude Code. https://t.co/RRsqqngMtL

sourceMaterials.text: @AlexanderJoh10 I might just buy a few of these as they are cheap enough: https://t.co/xxea4wn3bl
sourceMaterials.author: VectorCrossProd

sourceMaterials.text: @AlexanderJoh10 I use a couple of different DIN designs from https://t.co/2Yg3fxryqQ so I will be keen to see if this one works well or not.
sourceMaterials.author: VectorCrossProd

sourceMaterials.text: @AlexanderJoh10 Yep, it understands all the steps involved. Whether hardware, software, marketing. It has it.
sourceMaterials.author: VectorCrossProd

sourceMaterials.text: @jerlo42430095 I ran a claude code session in Ubuntu and asked it to use Kicad that met my needs. It calls kicad headless in the background and askes a few questions. I also asked it to check the JLCPCB inventory levels for parts and to select the cheapest parts for production in the design.
sourceMaterials.author: VectorCrossProd

sourceMaterials.text: @bygregorr I had Claude Opus 5.5 create the enclosure in FreeCAD and then generate the STLs as an export from FreeCAD. Then I open them in Slic3r for printing.
sourceMaterials.author: VectorCrossProd

sourceMaterials.text: @GermanDZ I love using OpenSCAD. I haven't opened it in about a year but I am keen to see what people can do with Opus 5.5 + OpenSCAD. I wonder how far we can push the complexity envelope.
sourceMaterials.author: VectorCrossProd

sourceMaterials.text: @ns_schoe For the animation video it was basically a single prompt. I said I wanted a 10s promotional video showing an exploded view animation of the enclosure and how it is used, that it is visually appealing but informative with text annotations
sourceMaterials.author: VectorCrossProd

sourceMaterials.text: @Issa201735 Are you prompting Claude via Claude Code on a Linux machine using Opus 5.5?
sourceMaterials.author: VectorCrossProd

sourceMaterials.text: @draslan_eth Yeah, it really understands how to make it look good
sourceMaterials.author: VectorCrossProd

sourceMaterials.text: It came up with a novel-to-me way to print a DIN clip https://t.co/NXUS5m0PVh
sourceMaterials.author: VectorCrossProd

sourceMaterials.text: So I prompted in Claude Code and it used Blender to render the existing STLs and added the annotations as a separate step.
sourceMaterials.author: VectorCrossProd
